desc: Simple, Basic, Fun and Customizable. That is the Steel Tyme Target. Use either your own firearm with a LaserLyte training cartridge or their TriggerTyme Training Firearms. These targets are the ultimate in basic training. No modes or scores to keep track of, these are great HIT/MISS targets for fundamental training. Utilizing multiple units allows you to position them in different locations/distances to engage in dynamic training.
